Holvik is one of the duergar accompanying  Gekh Coal to the Decrepit Village in Act One.
“
Half the squad dead for the sake of one runaway. Gh'rack.
„
— Holvik

Involvement

Act One

Holvik is part of Gekh Coal's task force to retrieve  Sergeant Thrinn's stolen boots. If a party member speaks with him as a non-drow, Holvik expresses disgust at their casualties, which were caused by Myconid hallucinations that led members to leap to their deaths.
